chunks: namely: associating partners with Allah the Exalted; killing the soul which Allah has forbidden; disrespecting parents; fleeing from the ranks in battle; devouring the property of an orphan oppressively; consuming usury after clear proof; falsely accusing chaste women; and after that adultery sodomy and theft; eating dead animals blood and pork and what is offered to other than Allah without necessity; consuming ill-gotten wealth; shortchanging in measure and weight; gambling; false testimony; losing hope in Allah's spirit (forgiveness); feeling secure from Allah's plot; despairing of Allah's mercy; abandoning helping the oppressed and leaning towards the tyrants; the false oath that drowns (in sin); withholding rights without hardship; using haughtiness arrogance lying extravagance and wastefulness; treachery; underestimating the Hajj; fighting the friends of Allah the Exalted; and entertainments that divert from the remembrance of Allah the Blessed and Exalted such as singing and playing strings are disliked as is persisting in minor sins.
随后他（愿主福安之）说：'这足以成为拜主者的凭据。'
本书编纂者愿真主喜悦之曰：大罪有七，其后尚有。故凡罪相对于较小者为大，相对于较大者为小。此即萨迪格（愿主赐福之）在此圣训中所述大罪超过七种之意，除真主外无有力量。
ai.seo_question: 什叶派圣训中列出的大罪有哪些，它们是如何定义的？
ai.summary: 谢赫·萨杜克在传统七大罪的基础上扩展了更广泛的严重罪行清单，包括逃跑和吞噬非法财富（苏赫）等具体罪行，同时强调罪过程度的相对性。这种分类反映了什叶派学者将法律禁令与精神状态（如绝望和傲慢）相联系的传统，为虔诚者提供全面指南。编译者的注释强调‘大罪’与‘小罪’是语境相关的，强化了坚持小罪可能使其升格为大罪的观点。
